definitionZh: 彩色插件-过滤器 CSS 属性指定了通过 SVG 滤波效果进行成像操作的色彩空间. 如果明确声明,CSS属性的值将超过元素属性中给出的任何值.
sourceDefinition: The color-interpolation-filters CSS property specifies the color space for imaging operations performed via SVG filter effects. If explicitly declared, the value of the CSS property overrides any value given in the element's attribute.
